title: Rebecca
author: Daphne du Maurier
protagonist: The second Mrs. de Winter (unnamed narrator)

beats.event: Working as paid companion to a rich American in Monte Carlo
Meets widower Maxim de Winter socially
Impulsively agrees to marry him after two weeks
Arrives at Manderley as the second Mrs. de Winter
Meets Mrs. Danvers, Rebecca's devoted former maid
Danvers taunts her that she can never match Rebecca
Shown Rebecca's preserved bedroom, kept as a shrine
Convinced Maxim still loves Rebecca and regrets marrying her
Costume ball is planned; Danvers picks her dress
Dress matches Rebecca's costume; Maxim recoils in fury
Danvers urges her to jump from Rebecca's window
A shipwreck offshore interrupts the moment
Divers find Rebecca's sunken sailboat with her body inside
Maxim confesses he shot Rebecca and never loved her
Inquest rules Rebecca's death a suicide
Favell tries to blackmail Maxim over the ruling
Doctor reveals Rebecca had terminal cancer
They race home to find Manderley in flames
